exact_missing_items: Keep detail_ref, report_ref, evidence_ref, usage_event_ref, workflow_refs, docker_refs, kubernetes_refs as record/provenance families, not route payload surrogates.
Keep resume_url only as serialized transport derived from canonical route identity.
This split will make the owner-doc rewrite much easier because most refs do not need replacement. The real conflict sits almost entirely on resume_url, not on the broader *_ref family.

Governance model must define 4 execution scopes: run = full canonical graph under deterministic runtime; work package = coherent precomputed subgraph with local overseer; feature seam = cross-package oversight scope; node = smallest executable unit

Each entity type must have its own lifecycle model — there is no single universal status enum: node lifecycle, work package lifecycle, feature seam lifecycle, promotion lifecycle, worktree lane lifecycle are all distinct

Three canonical promotion classes must be defined: lane_to_package (lane result → package baseline), package_to_seam_available (package → trusted seam contribution), seam_complete (seam marked complete)

Promotion gates must be defined at three levels: lane_to_package = local correctness + uncontaminated lane + required automated verification; package_to_seam_available = trusted baseline + package evidence + acceptable overseer verdict; seam_complete = integration review + no unresolved major/critical findings + seam evidence + no pending corroboration/remediation
'lane' object required fields: project/package linkage, worktree binding, lifecycle, contamination state, safe-point linkage, ancestry, ownership/display grouping
'resolution_thread' object required fields: trigger linkage, resolution kind, issue summary, allowed actions, status, UI/chat linkage

Governing layer design: deterministic scheduler/state machine (not one long-running super-agent); bounded worker/reviewer/remediation agents with explicit context windows; lightweight planning/replan agent only at graph-construction or graph-patch boundaries
